messages:
Nina (Docs): Quick QA/sync thread — I ran a pass over the function/tool-calling + structured-output docs and found: one dead external example link, multiple snippets still showing `tool_output` envelope, and no example showing how to validate example JSON programmatically. I'm starting a small PR to: 1) standardize on `output` envelope, 2) add a compact migration shim, and 3) add a tiny JS/Python validation snippet so readers can run the example against the schema. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8124

Ravi (SDK): I can handle the TS bits. For validation snippet, would you prefer AJV example or a link to our SDK validator?

Nina (Docs): AJV is fine for an immediate example (one-off). Also include a one-line note pointing to our SDK validator hook for prod use. Keep the docs example minimal.

Marta (Eng): On schema changes: I'll update the sample schema to use `output: { result: string }` and add `additionalProperties: false`. I also want to add a short comment about why that prevents silent regressions.

Sam (QA): Good call adding validation. Can we add a tiny docs- CI check that runs AJV against all JSON examples in docs/examples/? I can draft a GitHub Actions job if you want.

Nina (Docs): Yes please @Sam. Add a permissive job that runs only on docs changes and fails the PR if any example doesn't validate. Keep it soft-fail for the first week (warning) so we can triage.

Ravi (SDK): For TS snippet I'll rename `client.callTool(...)` -> `client.invoke(...)` and add a short legacy alias example with a comment `// legacy: callTool -> invoke`. Also include a streaming comment: `invoke(..., stream:true)` -> `for await (const chunk of resp) { ... }`.

Marta (Eng): I'll add the JSON Schema block: 
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "output": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "result": { "type": "string" }
      },
      "required": ["result"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": ["output"]
}
```
And include a tiny explanation: "Use additionalProperties:false so parsers flag stray keys early."

Nina (Docs): For the JS validation snippet: add this (compact):
```js
import Ajv from 'ajv'
const ajv = new Ajv()
const validate = ajv.compile(schema)
console.assert(validate(example), JSON.stringify(validate.errors, null, 2))
```
And a Python example using jsonschema: `jsonschema.validate(instance=example, schema=schema)`

Sam (QA): I'll prototype the GitHub Action: run node ajv-cli on examples/*.json and python -m jsonschema on the python examples. Will make it opt-in via path_filters and set to `continue-on-error: true` for the first run.

docs-bot: PR #8124 opened by @Nina — CI lint: ok, link-checker: 1 dead external link detected (old gist).

Ravi (SDK): Reviewing now, left two small comments on import paths in TS snippet. Also suggest we add a one-liner that shows `result = resp.output?.result ?? resp.tool_output?.result` as the migration shim.

Marta (Eng): I'll add that shim to the migration subsection. Good suggestion.

Nina (Docs): Thanks. I'll fix the dead link (replace gist with in-repo example) and land a follow-up that wires the docs- CI job. Target: merge tomorrow AM. If anyone is blocked, ping here. :pray:
